column1: # State hashes are raw canonical StateFile bytes and include the current Fetcher coordinates.
# Replay semantics v1 projects only those historically absent coordinates for legacy hashing.
# CGB/CGB0 SKIP captures also include HDMA lcdEnabled=true published from the post-boot GPU level.
# SKIP register presets include the silent chime/APU routing, JOYP and inactive HDMA5 state.
# Native CGB background palettes start at 7FFF, so its synthetic empty frame is white.
